info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Bremer River, Bremer River at Wanstead Rd and Bremer River at Langhorne Ck (Upstream)
info.description:
Minor flooding is occurring at Wanstead Rd and likely at Langhorne Creek.
The Bremer River at Wanstead Rd is currently around a peak at 3.85 m, with minor flooding. The Bremer River at Wanstead Rd may fall below the minor flood level (3.10 m) Tuesday evening.
The Bremer River at Langhorne Ck (Upstream) is currently at 1.70 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Bremer River at Langhorne Ck (Upstream) is likely to reach around the minor flood level (4.80 m) Tuesday afternoon.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.ses.sa.gov.au/incidents-and-warnings/incidents-and-warnings-map/.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
